title: fix(plugin-dashboard): a url header action goes through the action runner, and an omitted actionType runs as url (objectui#12275)
body:
Fixes #12275
Clause-②: no

A dashboard header action of type `url`, or one with no `actionType`, now goes through the ActionRunner like every other header action. The click used to navigate with a url check of its own, so it never reached `classifyNavigationTarget`, the runner's one answer to what a click may open (ruling A+ on objectui#12191, comment 6121792024). This PR follows the triage direction (comment 6134181226) and the seat's claim (comment 6134917028). Dispatched by `domain:ui` seat 1, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01CsyMRsFJBKNEMa4oPY1b5z`.

## What changed

All in `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DashboardRenderer.tsx`:

- **The click dispatches the def `headerActionDefs` builds, whatever its type.** The `actionType === 'url'` branch is deleted, together with its `^https?://` regex, its leading-`//` test, `location.assign` and the unconditional `pushState`. So is the guard that dropped an omitted `actionType` with "Header action missing actionType/actionUrl". The def's `type: actionType || 'url'` is the one reading of an omitted type, as the contract door reads it. The click never re-reads the authored `actionType`. The file holds no scheme test.
- **The runner's `redirect` hand-off is followed for a `url` action.** A runner with no navigation handler (no `ActionProvider` above the dashboard) does not navigate to an admitted in-app path. It returns `{ success: true, redirect: PATH }`. The click follows that hand-off with the same `history.pushState` + `popstate` it used before, so a provider-less embed still navigates in the app. `pushState` cannot leave the origin, and the runner sets `redirect` here only for a target it classified as an in-app path.
- **A `url` header action raises no success toast.** The def carries `toast: { showOnSuccess: false }` for `url`, so the console does not toast "completed successfully" after a navigation. It raised none before, and the html-tier anchor suppresses it the same way. The error toast stays, so a refusal is reported.

`@object-ui/core` is read and reused, not changed. The runner already provides everything this needs.

## Measurements (dispatch Zone 2)

1. **The handler, at `9f282ef`: confirmed as the dispatch describes it.** An omitted `actionType` returned early with `console.warn('[DashboardRenderer] Header action missing actionType/actionUrl:', …)`. For `url`, the handler called `location.assign` on a `^https?://` match or a leading `//`, else `history.pushState` + `popstate`. Every other type went through `executeAction`. `headerActionDefs` built `type: actionType || 'url'`.
2. **What the runner does with each target, measured by the new pins on a real render with the real runner:**
   - A refused target (`//cdn.example.com/x`, `thanks`): the runner answers `{ success: false, error: NAVIGATION_TARGET_REFUSAL }`. Under an `ActionProvider` with `onToast`, as the console's `GlobalActionRuntimeProvider` wires it, that is an error toast carrying the runner's refusal. With no provider there is no toast handler, and the dashboard logs `[DashboardRenderer] action failed` with the same error, as it does for every other header action. It is never a silent no-op, and no navigation sink is touched.
   - `mailto:`: `window.location.href` is set once, in place. There is no router call, no new tab and no throw.
   - An in-app `/apps/...` path: under a provider it goes to the host's navigation handler with `external: false` (react-router `navigate` in the console). With no provider the runner returns it as `redirect`, and the click follows it with `pushState` + `popstate`. That is the old `pushState` branch's behaviour, kept.
   - `https://`: under a provider it goes to the navigation handler with `external: true, newTab: true`, and the console opens it in a new tab. With no provider the runner calls `window.open(URL, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer')`.
3. **Nothing the runner lacks.** No change to `@object-ui/core`. The only addition on the dashboard side is following the runner's existing no-handler `redirect` hand-off, the same one the html-tier anchor follows.

## Published surface

- **No export, prop, type member, spec key or i18n key moves.** The edit sits inside a `useMemo` callback and an inline click closure of `DashboardRendererInner`. No declaration the package emits changes, so the package's `.d.ts` cannot move. That is a reading of the diff, not a dist byte comparison.
- **The header action click's runtime accept set moves onto the contract's own set** (`navigationTargetRefusal`, read by the claim's `Clause-② reason`):
  - **Narrowed:** a protocol-relative `//host` is refused; it used to be opened with `location.assign`. A value that is not `http://`, `https://`, `mailto:`, `/…` or `./…` is refused; it used to be pushed as a route. That covers `thanks`, and also `?tab=x`, `#frag` and any other scheme.
  - **Admitted, as the contract already admits:** `mailto:`, which used to throw in `pushState`, and an omitted `actionType`, which used to be dropped.
  - Nothing outside the contract's set is admitted, so `Clause-②: no`.
- **Behaviour that now follows the runner's conventions for every `url` action** (for the reviewer, none of it widens the set):
  - An `https://` target opens in a new tab under the console. It used to replace the current page.
  - A `${…}` expression in `actionUrl` is now interpolated and evaluated, as it is on every runner `url` target.
  - An `/api/`, `/_auth/` or `/_account/` path takes the runner's full-page navigation and its `apiBase` prefix.

## Tests

All at `e89a1e9` (this branch's head).

- **New pins:** `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DashboardRenderer.headerActionUrl-12275.test.tsx`. They run on a real `DashboardRenderer` with the real runner, twice: under an `ActionProvider` wired with `onNavigate` and `onToast` as the console wires it, and with no provider.
  - The card's four pins: `//cdn.example.com/x` is refused at the click; `mailto:` opens; a bare relative value is refused; an omitted-type header action with an `https://` target navigates.
  - The fifth pin: an in-app `/apps/...` path still navigates in the app.
  - "Refused" is read off the runner, not off prose: the dashboard surfaces exactly the error a bare runner answers for the same target, that answer is a failure, and no sink (router, `location.href`, `window.open`, `pushState`) is touched.
- **Fixture triage:** `DashboardRenderer.headerActions.test.tsx` had a case named "still navigates for a url header action instead of dispatching". It pinned the bypass this card removes (a host `url` handler NOT called). It is replaced, not re-spelled: `url` joins the `it.each` of types that must reach their handler.
- **Ablation, one leg, at `e89a1e9`:**
  - Mutation: `DashboardRenderer.tsx` was checked out from the base `9f282ef`. Landing was confirmed by blob hash (`3a7628c5…`, equal to the base blob) and by marker counts: `window.location.assign(actionUrl)` went 0 to 1, and the redirect follow went 1 to 0.
  - Result: the two header-action files gave `Tests 10 failed | 10 passed (20)`, the expected direction. All nine new-file pins that the fix changes went red, plus the `url` row of the existing `it.each`.
  - What stayed green: the no-provider in-app path pin (a CONTROL: the old `pushState` branch did the same thing), and the nine other rows of the existing file.
  - Restore: from `HEAD`. The blob was confirmed equal to the HEAD blob (`bcd4a5fd…`), `git diff HEAD` was empty, and a trap guarded the restore.
- **Whole package:** `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-dashboard/` gave `Test Files 176 passed (176)`, `Tests 1759 passed | 6 skipped (1765)`.
- **Importers that render the dashboard:** the five `packages/app-shell/src/views/DashboardView.*.test.tsx` suites, plus `examples/schema-catalog/test/plugin-dashboard-gallery-render.test.tsx` and `plugin-dashboard-component-schema.test.ts`. Result: `Test Files 7 passed (7)`, `Tests 69 passed (69)`.
- **Type-check:** `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-dashboard type-check` echoed `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` and exited 0. This ran after `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/plugin-dashboard^...` (12 tasks successful). `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists both header-action test files.
- **Gates, all exit 0:**
  - `check-changeset-presence`: "3 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)".
  - `check:new-line-citations`: "VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)".
  - `check:control-bytes`: OK.
  - `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:action-forward-parity` and `check:action-ref-convention`: all OK.
- **Lint, narrowed and proven:** `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the 3 touched `.ts` / `.tsx` files reported 3 files, 0 errors and 8 warnings. All 8 are in `DashboardRenderer.tsx`, and the base blob linted the same way gives the same 8 rules (6 `no-explicit-any`, 2 `exhaustive-deps`), shifted only by the inserted lines. The new and edited test files have 0. Why the narrowing excludes nothing:
  1. The population comes from `eslint.config.js`, whose `files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx}']` holds all three.
  2. The count, 3, is read from the JSON output.
  3. The config has no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`), and no local rule in `eslint-rules/` reads the filesystem. So this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.
- **NOT MEASURED, left to CI:**
  - `pnpm lint` over the tree.
  - The full `@object-ui/app-shell` suite. This is a declared narrowing: every app-shell suite that renders the dashboard ran above.
  - `check:eager-closure`: the diff adds no import, so no eager module edge moves.

## Acceptance notes

- **`form` and the objectui-local `navigation` type in a provider-less host.** The runner hands their route back as `redirect` too, and this click follows the hand-off for `url` only, as the card scopes it. Such a header action in an embed with no `ActionProvider` still does not navigate, as before this PR. The console always mounts a provider. Read from source, not reproduced. Not filed; carrier: none.
- **Two header actions with one `actionUrl`** register under one engine name, so the second def replaces the first and both buttons run the second. This was already true of every non-`url` type and is unchanged here. Read from source. Not filed; carrier: none.
- **`modalHandler` / `scriptHandlers` are installed on `engine.getRunner()`.** Under the console that is the shared provider runner, so a dashboard's handlers stay installed on it after the dashboard unmounts. This is unchanged here. Read from source, not measured. Not filed; carrier: none.
- **Docs:** no page under `content/docs` and no package README describes how a dashboard header `url` action navigates (searched for `actionUrl`, `actionType` and header-action wording), so none became false.
- **Changeset:** `.changeset/12275-dashboard-header-action-runner.md`, `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` `patch`.
